0022600034.text: The New York Knicks (6-5, 5th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (4-8, 10th in the East) in the Knicks' 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with New York coming off a loss while Indiana has won its last game. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard and Johnny Furphy, who are both out with knee injuries, and Tyrese Haliburton, who is out with a hamstring strain, while Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. The Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-110 win over Indiana in New York on March 17, 2026, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
